anchors.derivation: Drozdov, Kong, Minkov, Besedin, Kuzovnikov, Mozaffari, Balicas, Balakirev, Graf, Prakapenka, Greenberg, Knyazev, Tkacz, Eremets. "Superconductivity at 250 K in lanthanum hydride under high pressures." Nature 569, 528-531 (2019). DOI 10.1038/s41586-019-1201-8. The paper's own confirmed headline critical temperature (~250 K at ~170 GPa) for LaH10, used here as the score=1.0 witness -- an experimental measurement, not something this task's Allen-Dynes-formula oracle re-derives from first principles.
